December, 2024

Author: Kuldeep Mathur Bench: Kuldeep Mathur [2024:RJ-JD:50856]
 HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR  S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous Bail Application No. 15377/2024 Sharwan S/o Bheru Lal, Aged About 24 Years, R/o Nandolai Ka Kheda, P.s. Badliyas, Dist Bhilwara . (Presently Residing To Sitarampuri, Colony 200Ft. By Pass Ke Pass Mochada , Jaipur)
(Presently Lodged In Cnetral Jail Bhilwara)
 ----Petitioner  Versus 1. State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp 2. Balu Lal Luhar S/o Ram Chandra Luhar, Aged About 20  Years, R/o Nandolai Ka Kheda, Badliyas, Dist Bhilwara .

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: ----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr. S.K. Bhati For Respondent(s) : Mr. Urja Ram Kalbi, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 11/12/2024 1.

This application for bail under Section 483 BNSS (439 Cr.P.C.) has been filed by the petitioner who has been arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.72/2022, registered at Police Station Badliyas,
District Bhilwara, for offences under Sections 363, 366A, 344, 376(2)(n), 376(a)(b) of IPC; and Sections 5(l)(m)/6 of POCSO Act.

2. Drawing attention of the Court towards the statements of the victim- 'S' recorded before the competent criminal Court on 19.11.2024, learned counsel submitted that the victim- 'S' during her Court statements has not supported the prosecution story and has turned hostile.

Learned counsel submitted that the victim- 'S' in her Court statements even during the cross-examination by the [2024:RJ-JD:50856] (2 of 3) [CRLMB-15377/2024] learned Public Prosecutor did not level any allegation of she being subjected to forcible sexual assault- rape by the present petitioner.
Sharwan vs State Of Rajasthan (2024:Rj-Jd:50856) on 11 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/110731570/
1

3 . Lastly, learned counsel submitted that the petitioner is in judicial custody and the trial of the case will take sufficiently long time, therefore, the benefit of bail may be granted to the accused- petitioner.
4. Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor has vehemently opposed the bail application.

However, he was not in a position to refute the facts that the victim 'S' during her Court statements has not supported the prosecution story and has turned hostile; and so also the victim- 'S' during her Court statements has not levelled any allegation of she being subjected to forcible sexual assault- rape by the present petitioner.
5. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor.
Perused the material available on record.

6. Having considered the rival submissions, facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on merits/demerits of the case, this Court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
7. Consequently, the bail application under Section 483 BNSS (439 Cr.P.C.) is allowed.

It is ordered that the accused-petitioner- Sharwan S/o Bheru Lal, arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.72/2022,
registered at Police Station Badliyas, District Bhilwara, shall be released on bail, if not wanted in any other case, provided he furnishes a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- and two sureties of Rs.25,000/-
each, to the satisfaction of learned trial court, for his appearance before that court on each & every [2024:RJ-JD:50856] (3 of 3) [CRLMB-15377/2024] date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till completion of the trial.
8. It is however, made clear that findings recorded/observations made above are for limited purposes of adjudication of bail application.
The trial court shall not get prejudiced by the same.
